transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our routine waste-disposition huddle. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area, and I need to hear from both of you before I sign off on the final disposition and shipment plan. Environmental compliance, can you walk me through your findings first, and then logistics, I'll need your carrier and scheduling recommendations. No pickup has been booked yet, so let's figure out what we need to get this moving.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical change in classification. My laboratory review this morning classified the solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II, rather than routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. The classification is not yet in the formal waste register because I'm waiting for your disposition signature, Mara.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've confirmed with the licensed hazardous-waste carrier that it will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I haven't booked the pickup yet because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation, which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3
